main_text.p: que bello uno forte atque altero loco excepto, sic hodie illi aut raro, aut nunquam applicabi-tur. Verùm quia nomina rerum significandarum gratiâ sunt adinventa, nec aliquem oportet esse tam de vocabulis, quàm de rebus follicitum, quod jura potiùs rebus, quàm verbis lata sint: ad explicatio-nem materiæ propositæ, relicto cuivis circa usum vocabuli suo judicio, memet transferam.l. 2. in fin. Cod. comm. de leg. Ubi primùm ex-aminanda venit definitio, seu mavis descriptio, circa quam etiam scriptores dissentire consueverunt & plerique meo judicio fuerunt hallucinati. Verùm priusquam aliorum sententias ad incudem re-vocem, præ-notabo duellum, quandoque in laxiore accipi significatione, scil. pro quocumque certamine duorum, vel licito, vel illicito, le-

page.notes: The catchword "gibus" completes the word "legibus" from the last line. The marginal note reads "l. 2. in fin. Cod. comm. de leg." across three short lines in the left margin. The word "præ-notabo" is printed with a soft break; I read it as "præ notabo" and transcribed it as "præ-notabo", but the line-break hyphen is uncertain. The "-" marks at the top right corner and the faint marks at the bottom are scan edges and were left out.
